refrain.d: To hold back, to restrain (someone or something).

refresh.e: Sleep refreshes the body and the mind.

refuge.d: A state of safety, protection or shelter.

refute.d: To prove (something) to be false or incorrect.

rehearsal.d: The practising of something which is to be performed before an audience, usually to test or improve the interaction between several participating people, or to allow technical adjustments with respect to staging to be done.
rehearsal.e: The forest fires are just a rehearsal for the devastation that will be caused if climate change continues to worsen.

reinforce.d: To strengthen, especially by addition or augmentation.
reinforce.e: The right homework will reinforce and complement the lesson!

reinforcement.d: The act, process, or state of reinforcing or being reinforced.
reinforcement.e: There's a website that can be a good learning reinforcement.

related.e: Electric and magnetic forces are closely related.

relay.e: The CCTV cameras relay what's going on to the headquarters.

relief.d: The removal of stress or discomfort.
relief.e: I sighed with relief when I found out that my daughter hadn't got lost, but was waiting for me at home.

reluctant.e: She was reluctant to lend him the money

remaining.d: To stay behind while others withdraw; to be left after others have been removed or destroyed; to be left after a number or quantity has been subtracted or cut off; to be left as not included or comprised.
remaining.e: May I have the only remaining cake?

rental.e: It's just a rental, so I don't need to take very good care of it.

replacement.d: A person or thing that takes the place of another; a substitute.
replacement.e: The replacement of that broken light-bulb will have to wait until I can buy a new one.

resistance.d: The act of resisting, or the capacity to resist.
resistance.e: the resistance of bacteria to certain antibiotics

retreat.d: The act of pulling back or withdrawing, as from something dangerous, or unpleasant.

retrieve.e: to retrieve one's character or independence; to retrieve a thrown ball

revelation.d: The act of revealing or disclosing.

revenue.d: The income returned by an investment.

revolution.d: A political upheaval in a government or nation state characterized by great change.

rip.d: To divide or separate the parts of (especially something flimsy, such as paper or fabric), by cutting or tearing; to tear off or out by violence.
rip.e: to rip a garment; to rip up a floor

risky.e: Investing in this start-up company could be risky.

ritual.d: Rite; a repeated set of actions
ritual.e: They carried out the ritual carefully.

rival.d: A competitor (person, team, company, etc.) with the same goal as another, or striving to attain the same thing. Defeating a rival may be a primary or necessary goal of a competitor.
rival.e: Chris is my biggest rival in the 400-metre race.

roam.d: To wander or travel freely and with no specific destination.
roam.e: Gangs of thugs roamed the streets.

roar.d: A long, loud, deep shout, as of rage or laughter, made with the mouth wide open.
roar.e: The audience roared at his jokes.

rocket.d: A projectile. A cylindrical projectile that can be fired to a great height through combustion, a type of firework of this form, typically exploding with light and colour; a skyrocket. A blunt lance head used in jousting. A long vehicle or craft propelled by a rocket engine; a missile or rocket-propelled spacecraft. An engine operating similarly to the pyrotechnic, generating thrust by the expulsion of hot gases; a rocket engine.

rocky.d: Abounding in, or full of, rocks; consisting of rocks.
rocky.e: a rocky mountain a rocky shore

roommate.d: A person with whom one shares a room, as in a dormitory, barracks, rooming house, or apartment.

rosy.e: I fancy a cup of rosy.

route.d: A course or way which is traveled or passed.
route.e: The route was used so much that it formed a rut.

rub.e: Give that lamp a good rub and see if any genies come out.

rubble.d: The broken remains of an object, usually rock or masonry.

rug.d: A partial covering for a floor.

rural.d: A person from the countryside; a rustic.

salary.d: A fixed amount of money paid to a worker, usually calculated on a monthly or annual basis, not hourly, as wages. Implies a degree of professionalism and/or autonomy.

salsa.d: A spicy tomato sauce of Mexican origin, often including onions and hot peppers.
salsa.e: They salsaed late until the night.

scar.d: A permanent mark on the skin, sometimes caused by the healing of a wound.

sector.d: A section. (Can we add an example for this sense?)

seminar.d: A class held for advanced studies in which students meet regularly to discuss original research, under the guidance of a professor.

sensitive.d: A person with a paranormal sensitivity to something that most cannot perceive.

serene.e: She looked at her students with joviality and a serene mentality.

sharply.d: In a sharp manner, in various senses. So as to terminate in a sharp point or edge.
sharply.e: The stick was sharply tapered at one end.

shatter.d: Of brittle solid materials (like glass or ice), to violently break into pieces.
shatter.e: The miners used dynamite to shatter rocks.

shipwreck.d: A ship that has sunk or run aground so that it is no longer seaworthy; a ruined vessel or its remains.

shooting.e: Shooting beams of light played over the sea.

shoplift.d: To steal something from a shop or store during business hours, usually by means of hiding merchandise.

shoplifter.d: A person who shoplifts, one who steals from shops.

short-term.d: Of or pertaining to the near or immediate future.
short-term.e: This short-term plan deals with the next few days.

showcase.d: A case for displaying merchandise or valuable items.
showcase.e: I think the demonstration really showcases the strengths of the software.

shrink.e: This garment will shrink when wet.

shrug.d: A lifting of the shoulders to signal indifference or a casual lack of knowledge.
shrug.e: He dismissed my comment with a shrug.

significantly.d: In a significant manner or to a significant extent.

signify.d: To create a sign out of something.

sketch.d: A rapidly executed freehand drawing that is not intended as a finished work, often consisting of a multitude of overlapping lines.
sketch.e: I usually sketch with a pen rather than a pencil.

skip.d: A leaping, jumping or skipping movement.
skip.e: She will skip from one end of the sidewalk to the other.

slang.d: Language outside of conventional usage and in the informal register.

so-called.d: So named; commonly called by such a name, often with a connotation that the item is not worthy of that name.
so-called.e: These so-called "assistants" are making our jobs harder, not easier!

sociable.e: He's normally pretty quiet, but he gets much more sociable around women.

solar.d: Of or pertaining to the sun; proceeding from the sun.

sophisticated.d: To make less natural or innocent.

soybean.d: A legume plant (Glycine max), commonly cultivated for human and animal consumption and as a nitrogen-fixing ground cover.

spa.d: A health resort near a mineral spring or hot spring.

spare.d: The act of sparing; moderation; restraint.

specialty.d: That in which one specializes; a chosen expertise or talent.
specialty.e: They cook well overall, but their true specialty is pasta.

specifically.d: In a specific manner, applying to or naming a particular thing or things, expressly, explicitly

spectacle.d: An exciting or extraordinary scene, exhibition, performance etc.
spectacle.e: The horse race was a thrilling spectacle.

spellbound.d: Under the influence of a magical spell; enchanted, bewitched, or supernaturally constrained.
spellbound.e: The story left the children spellbound.

spin.e: He put some spin on the cue ball.

splatter.d: An uneven shape or mess created by something dispersing on impact.

spokesman.d: One who speaks as the voice of another person or a group of people.

spokeswoman.d: A woman who speaks as the voice of a group of people.

spray.d: A fine, gentle, dispersed mist of liquid.
spray.e: The sailor could feel the spray from the waves.

spreadsheet.d: A computer application for organization, analysis, and storage of data in tabular form.

sprint.d: A short race at top speed.

spur.d: A rigid implement, often roughly y-shaped, that is fixed to one's heel for the purpose of prodding a horse. Often worn by, and emblematic of, the cowboy or the knight.

squad.d: A group of people organized for some common purpose, usually of about ten members.
squad.e: He assembled a squad of ten to take on the assassin.

squash.d: A sport played in a walled court with a soft rubber ball and bats like tennis racquets.

squeeze.e: I'm in a tight squeeze right now when it comes to my free time.

stability.d: The condition of being stable or in equilibrium, and thus resistant to change.

stack.e: Please stack those chairs in the corner.

stake.d: A piece of wood or other material, usually long and slender, pointed at one end so as to be easily driven into the ground as a marker or a support or stay.

starvation.d: A condition of severe suffering due to a lack of nutrition.

steer.d: A suggestion about a course of action.
steer.e: I find it very difficult to steer a skateboard.

stool.d: A seat, especially for one person and without armrests.

strand.d: The shore or beach of the sea or ocean; shore; beach.

striking.d: (sometimes with out or through) To delete or cross out; to scratch or eliminate.
striking.e: He looked quite striking in his new suit and tie.

submit.d: To yield or give way to another.
submit.e: They will not submit to the destruction of their rights.

subside.d: To sink or fall to the bottom; to settle, as lees.

subtle.d: Hard to grasp; not obvious or easily understood; barely noticeable.
subtle.e: The difference is subtle, but you can hear it if you listen carefully.

suck.d: An instance of drawing something into one's mouth by inhaling.

sue.d: To file a legal action against someone, generally a non-criminal action.

sufficiently.e: Once we had eaten and drunk sufficiently, we went to bed.

suitably.d: In a suitable manner; with propriety.

sulfur.d: A chemical element with atomic number 16, having a bright yellow color and characteristic smell, used commercially in a variety of products such as insecticides, black powder, and matchsticks.

sunbeam.d: A ray of sunlight; especially, a demarcated, narrow, and intense (relative to ambient light) ray of sunlight (as revealed by, for example, its diffraction among dust particles).

superb.d: First-rate; of the highest quality; exceptionally good.

superintendent.d: A person who is authorized to supervise, direct or administer something.

supernatural.d: Above nature; beyond or added to nature, often so considered because it is given by a deity or some force beyond that with which humans are born.
supernatural.e: In Roman Catholic theology, sanctifying grace is considered to be a supernatural addition to human nature.
